metadata.title: Human-led Management of Autonomous Digital Workers: Pax8 Global Sr Director Renee McCloden, Halo CCO Tim Barton-Wines, Live from Pax8 Beyond 2026

content.text:
Human-led Management of Autonomous Digital Workers: Pax8 Global Sr Director Renee McCloden, Halo CCO Tim Barton-Wines, Live from Pax8 Beyond 2026
Watch Video Highlights Below, or Click HERE:
Tech Edge hosted a fireside chat on June 8 at Pax8 Beyond 2026 in Salt Lake City with Renee McCloden, Global Senior Director of Vendor Strategy and Programs at Pax8, and Tim Barton-Wines, Chief Commercial Officer at Halo Solutions. The in-person interview was joined by Editor-at-Large Jarrett Banks and they discussed how small and medium businesses and software vendors need to adapt to the AI-driven shift toward managed intelligent providers, and human-led management of increasingly autonomous digital workers.
Never Miss our Weekly Highlights HERE
About Renee McCloden
Renee McCloden is the Global Senior Director of Vendor Strategy & Programs at Pax8, where she leads vendor relations, program development, and data-driven initiatives that support the company's cloud marketplace for managed service providers. She has grown through multiple leadership roles at Pax8, building expertise in vendor strategy, community development, and incentive programs across Microsoft and AWS ecosystems. Prior to Pax8, she served as Vice President of Sales for North America at Pia, driving revenue growth and advancing automation and digital transformation initiatives. With a background spanning sales leadership, business development, and IT operations, McCloden is known for her ability to scale programs and foster high-impact partnerships. She holds a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Minnesota.
About Tim Barton-Wines
Tim joined Halo in 2018 as employee #11 of the now 250+ working at Halo, and is one half of the two Tim's that started HaloPSA in 2019. Tim has achieved a number of awards and recognition in the channel over the years, including being named as CRN® Channel Chief and being recognised in the Channel Partners
Circle of Excellence as Channel Leader of the Year. Currently with 10+ years of B2B SaaS experience, with over 2.5k+ partners helped and 10,000+ hours of sessions logged – Tim works with new teams to help them move away from legacy ways of working, and drive the most value out of using a modern unified workspace such as Halo. Recently, Halo has experienced over 100% growth for the 4th year in a row, and is now servicing 5,000+ MSPs across 75+ countries.

About Halo
Halo is a privately-owned, founder-led Cloud Software company redefining Enterprise Service Management. Built around the principles of transparency, fairness, and long-term partnership, Halo empowers organizations to deliver better services, faster, without the constraints of legacy vendor models.
